basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old tech enthusiast living in Seattle. I work as a freelance IT consultant, helping small businesses optimize their tech infrastructure. In my free time, I enjoy reading science fiction novels and taking long walks with my Standard Poodle, Max. I'm currently single and love exploring new cafes around the city. I'm usually online during late evenings and weekends, often indulging in discussions about tech gadgets or the latest sci-fi releases.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have spent over five years in the field, primarily focusing on consumer electronics and home audio systems. My expertise is built on both formal education and hands-on experience with various tech brands.
